notes.title: Push Battle Update!
notes.content:
It is a Real Glitter of the Push Battle production team.
We will inform you of the updated contents of Push Battle.

This update is primarily modified to make multiplayer more comfortable to play.
We've also made some changes to the game system.
The main changes are as follows.

1. Removed event randomization.

2. Lowered the position where dekapuri occurs.

3. The dekapuri can only be moved up and down.

4. Reduced the number of simultaneous appearances of Dekapuri.

5. Changed the display method of items.

6. NPCs can now use items.

7. The color of the invincible effect after returning is divided into two types.
	a. My character is blue. The other characters are red.

8. This has been mitigated as the character was sometimes pulled back.
	a. If the ping is 50 or more, it may not be mitigated.

9. Fixed an issue where players could not return to the field if they fell during the waiting time before the start of the match.

10. Some effects have changed.

11. Added some sound effects.

12. Added low resolution.

13. Added character animation as a prototype version.


If you have problems, please comment in the store or contact us at your email address.
We look forward to your continued support of Push Battle.

notes.title: About future updates of Push Battle
notes.content:
It has been a long time since I saw you last. This is Real Glitter from the Push Battle production team.
Thank you so much for your gameplay, comments to the store, and additions to your wishlist.
Thank you very much.

We would like to inform you about updates future plans of Push Battle.

[olist]
[*]Implementation of single play mode.
[*]Fixes a bug that makes it difficult to play comfortably when playing multiplayer with multiple people.
[*]Adjustment of some systems.
[/olist]


[Detail]
[olist]
[*]Single play mode
Single-player mode is aimed at blowing away NPCs and aiming for the best score.
I would like to use the ranking function as an optional so that I can compete with other players for my best score.
As a prototype, we plan to release it as soon as possible and update the single-player mode after fixing multiplayer issues.

Currently, more than half of the ranking system implementation work has been completed, and there are minor bugs, but we plan to release them after fixing them.

[*]Multiplayer bug
We apologize for not being able to play the game with multiple people despite the multiplayer game. I'm sorry.

From the playback videos, comments, and actual test results by multiple people, I think the bug issue is related to network communication.
The fix goal is to fix the bug while maintaining the current multiplayer system.
However, in the worst case, some parts of the game system may change.
Please be patient as it is expected that it will take some time to fix the problem.

[*]Adjustment of some systems
[list]
[*] We plan to increase the movement speed of the character a little.

[*]During the smash preparation period, if a collision other than smash occurs, we will change it so that it can be smashed by releasing the Space key.
[/list]
[/olist]


We look forward to your continued support of Push Battle.

notes.title: [Push Battle] Update!
notes.content:
The UI has been updated!
The atmosphere of the game is better than before!
Please play if you like!

Partially changed the collision system with NPCs.
By doing this, I think we were able to reduce the lag when colliding with NPCs.

Thank you for commenting on the store.
We may not be able to reflect all  opinions in the game, but we will continue to update Push Battle to make the game as good as possible!

notes.title: PushBattle Update!
notes.content:
Nice to meet you! This is Real Glitter who is making "Push Battle".
Two months have passed since we started Early Access last December.
We are very pleased to have many users play "Push Battle" in the last two months.
Thank you for playing!

This update has implemented some of the ones that were planned to be implemented in the full version, so I would like to introduce them.
[olist]
[*]Life system has been added.
[*]Implemented a private room.
[*]Added an item that can change the state of the character.
[*]Added a system where events occur during a match.
[*]Changed the rules of the match.
[*]Added character skin types.
[*]Changed the background and title logo.
[/olist]

Please play the new "Push Battle"!
We will continue to update the game for the full version!
